capabilities: Browse and search an anime shelf by season, status or recent downloads
Subscribe to subtitle-group RSS feeds and download episodes with qBittorrent
Play local episodes in a configured player with merged Bilibili danmaku
Align danmaku timing with local audio
Sync watched progress, ratings and reviews to Bangumi
disambiguation: Not a link or backlink tool; it manages an anime shelf with downloads, playback and Bangumi synchronization.
extras: Credentials are stored unencrypted in data.json, so the file should be kept in private storage; cleanup actions delete actual media files; startup scheduling uses Windows scripts; mobile, macOS and Linux builds still need end-to-end verification.
problem: Finding, downloading, watching and tracking anime means switching between Bangumi, RSS feed sites, a torrent client and a local player.

relations.evidence: Download episodes with qBittorrent and open local files in your configured player.
Update watched progress manually, save ratings and reviews, and push changes through the Bangumi task queue.
Match Bilibili episode sources from selected uploaders, merge XML danmaku
Search Bangumi and find subtitle-group feeds through Mikan, or provide a custom RSS feed.
DanDanPlay is recommended for video and companion XML danmaku.
Other Obsidian plugins, ANI-RSS, AutoBangumi and public danmaku proxy services are optional integrations.

summary: Anime dashboard combining Bangumi search, subtitle-group RSS subscriptions, qBittorrent downloads, local playback with Bilibili danmaku, and progress sync.
